Usage:
  prime-agent list [--all] [--json] | list --check

List agents.

--check follows only the session dir an unqualified listing scans. It does not consult --session-dir, PRIME_AGENT_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR, or the settings sessionDir.

Options:
  -a, --all  Include saved agents
  --check     Report nested session-artifacts roots (text report only; no other listing options)
  --json      Print JSON
